title: Pure Gladiator Beast
summary: Gladiator Beast cards with generic staples. The page's combo lines add Tri-Brigade, Speedroid and X-Saber cards, so they use cards this list leaves out. The 2025 support leads: Flavian searches a Gladiator Beast, Gistel summons itself with another and searches a Gladiator Spell/Trap when tagged in, and Test Panther and Dareios tag monsters out of the Deck without a Battle Phase. Claudius sits on top with five Gladiator Beasts from the field or GY.
main: Gladiator Beast Gistel
2025 support. Reveals itself and another Gladiator Beast to summon both; summoned by a Gladiator Beast, searches a Gladiator Spell/Trap.
Gladiator Beast Laquari
2100 ATK when tagged in; the material Heraklinos names.
Gladiator Beast Bestiari
Tagged in: destroys a Spell/Trap; the material Gyzarus names.
Gladiator Beast Darius
Tagged in: revives a Gladiator Beast from the GY.
Gladiator Beast Equeste
Tagged in: gets a Gladiator Beast card back from the GY.
Gladiator Beast Murmillo
Tagged in: destroys a face-up monster.
Gladiator Beast Attorix
Tagged in: sends a Gladiator Beast from the Deck or Extra Deck to the GY and copies its name and Level.
Gladiator Beast Noxious
Steps in front of a direct attack; tagged in, sends a Gladiator Beast from the Deck to the GY.
Gladiator Beast Augustus
Tagged in: summons another Gladiator Beast from the hand; the material Andabata names.
Gladiator Beast Vespasius
Joins from the hand when a Gladiator Beast battles; the material Domitianus names.
Gladiator Beast Sagittarii
Tagged in: discards a Gladiator Beast card to draw two.
Flavian - Colosseum of the Gladiator Beasts
2025 support. Field Spell: discards to search a Gladiator Beast, summons one from the Deck against an attack, and Sets a Gladiator Trap.
Gladiator Proving Ground
Searches a Level 4 or lower Gladiator Beast.
Gladiator Beast's Comeback
Revives a Gladiator Beast of a new Type that can't be destroyed by battle.
Gladiator Rejection
Shields Gladiator Beasts from targeting outside the Battle Phase, and summons another from the Deck when one is tagged in.
Gladiator Beast United
During the Battle Phase, shuffles materials back to bring out a Gladiator Beast Fusion.
Gladiator Beast War Chariot
Counter Trap: negates a monster effect while you control a Gladiator Beast.
Gladiator Beast Charge
Destroys a face-up card for each differently named Gladiator Beast you control.
extra: 2025 support. Five Gladiator Beasts from the field or GY: two Battle Phases, and summons more Gladiator Beasts whenever the opponent activates a monster effect.
